text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After praying at a shrine with Agnes
Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not about to complain about having
come all
the way to this shrine...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you've prayed for, it seems
important
enough that you'd seek the
intervention of a
higher power.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But if you're done now, I'd say we can
go.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, just a little out of sorts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the macrophages in me are
slacking off
and leaving my apoptotic
debris unattended to.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That was a contextless joke, of course.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if my macrophages truly weren't
doing
their job, it wouldn't be a question
of just my
mood.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I guess it doesn't really matter anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears something has really gotten
her down.
I'd like to do something to
make her feel better,
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Don't tell me you're planning to
pray for me
to get better!
choice_data_list: I'm gonna go pray one more time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You think doing so is going to change
anything?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But then again, you are the simple type.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I can't remain in this daze
forever...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll conduct an experiment to lift
my spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She smiles playfully, indicating she
might be back
to her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I won't stop you if it'll make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But, don't get your hopes up about me
today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We probably aren't going to get any
useful
information while I'm feeling like
this, no matter
what we do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon lets out a big sigh. It
appears she
can't get back to her normal
self.
